d: Unofficial PS Vita port of the iOS version of DJMAX Ray (Neowiz / Pentavision).
ld: The port is a loader. It runs the game's own iOS ARM code natively on the Vita, with the iOS system parts (Objective-C runtime, Foundation, UIKit, CoreGraphics, OpenGL ES, OpenAL, AudioToolbox) replaced by Vita code. No game files are included. You need your own copy of the iOS app (.ipa).
req:
- kubridge v0.3.1 or later by bythos14
- libshacccg.suprx (Sony's shader compiler) in ur0:data/ or ur0:data/external/.
